gap_scope.validation_scope: Documentation semantic/owner/integration gates only; clinical/runtime release gates remain open

formulas.REVIEW_PROGRESS: 100 * reviewed original IDs / actual original source count
formulas.NORMALIZATION_PROGRESS: 100 * normalized original IDs / actual original source count
formulas.CANONICALIZATION_PROGRESS: 100 * canonicalized original IDs / actual original source count
formulas.GAP_FILL_PROGRESS: 100 * validated closed specification gaps / 7 identified scoped specification gaps
formulas.IMPLEMENTATION_READINESS: 100 * implementation-ready original IDs / actual original source count
formulas.OVERALL_PRODUCT_BIBLE_PROGRESS: min(REVIEW_PROGRESS, NORMALIZATION_PROGRESS, CANONICALIZATION_PROGRESS, GAP_FILL_PROGRESS, IMPLEMENTATION_READINESS); conservative weakest gate, not labour estimate
formulas.AUDIT_WORK_PROGRESS: 100 * (REVIEWED + NORMALIZED + CANONICALIZED) / (3 * 5175); equal-weight documentation work steps, not clinical readiness or time spent
